response.text:
Journal 2485 was posted on 20241022 into period 9, which closed on 20241005. Posted rows can't be edited and a closed period can't be posted to, so the fix is a reversing journal in an open period.

The reversal flips each original line: credit 5400 for 1637.42, debit 2100 for 818.71, and debit 1200 for 818.71. This balances on its own. The original plus the reversal net to zero, so the late entry is removed from the closed period's position and its effect lands in an open period. I chose period 11, the earliest open period, and it is where the transaction belongs in date terms. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.

The accrual may be a genuine one that should stand. If so, it could be re-posted properly in period 11. That would be a separate decision, and the finding supports only the minimal reversal here.
